observations.description: CLI exposes exactly two subcommands: 'deliver' and 'import-acknowledgements'. No other operations. Missing/unknown subcommand exits with error.
CLI output for both deliver and import-acknowledgements always includes trading_authority=False. Deliver output: state=DELIVERED, receipt_count. Ack output: state=ACKNOWLEDGEMENTS_IMPORTED, count.
PowerShell runner targets only OneDrive\TradingSystem\AlertEvidence. No other OneDrive or unrelated paths.
Reads only alerts.jsonl (watchdog spool) and sink-manifest.json. Validates manifest existence. Does not read other OneDrive content.
Writes via Python CLI (monitoring.off_host_alert_delivery deliver). Receipts path is local (outputs\operational_health\alert-delivery-receipts). No direct file writes in PS1.
No credential access (Get-Credential, SecureString, password, api_key). No strategy/trading data. No .env. No unrelated cloud (SharePoint/Azure/AWS).
Missing OneDrive, Python runtime, alert spool, sink manifest all throw. Delivery failure throws. ErrorActionPreference=Stop.
Process-level $env:OneDrive precedes user-level GetEnvironmentVariable('OneDrive','User'). IsNullOrWhiteSpace triggers fallback.
Join-Path handles spaces in paths. Sink path with spaces tested in Python deliver_alerts.
Idempotent delivery: existing identical envelope accepted. Conflicting cloud file (tampered envelope) rejects with 'conflicts'.

No task control (Register/Unregister/Enable/Disable/Start/Stop/Set/New-ScheduledTask). No process control (Start/Stop-Process). No network cmdlets. No recorder references. Python has no network imports or trading control.

Disclaims authenticated acknowledgements ('not cryptographically authenticated'), institutional readiness ('Institutional readiness requires'), no guaranteed availability. Describes OneDrive connector and scheduling as separate.

No scheduling: no Register-ScheduledTask, no New-ScheduledTask, no RepetitionInterval, no New-TimeSpan. No install/enable script for OneDrive connector. Documentation states scheduling is a separate audited step.
